The '''''Tri-Scythe''-class frigate''' was a variant of the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Three_blade_fiend.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A three-bladed ''Scythe'' in fleet-formation.]]
The ''Tri-Scythe''-class was based on the ''Scythe''-class, but had three blade-like structures instead of the single one featured on regular battle cruisers of the line. It was also larger and bulkier than contemporary Alliance frigates like the [[ShaShore-class frigate|''ShaShore''-class]], due to the increased amount of reactors and power generators needed to feed the weapons-batteries on the three forward blade-structures. The immense power-distribution system was similar to the one on the larger ''Scythe''-class.<ref name="LECG" />

In terms of weaponry, the ''Tri-Scythe''-class had less than the ''Scythe''-class, but more than the ''ShaShore''-class. The ship was less maneuverable than the other frigates due to the extra power-support systems adding to the bulk of the craft, and the ''Tri-Scythe'' could be outflanked by enemy ships targeting its sides and rear. In addition to more armament, the carried craft complement was also a bit higher than on contemporary frigates.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
At least one ship of this type served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. It escaped the [[Battle of Caamas]] at the war's end, and remained as part of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]], on the run from [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWL:I" /> In [[137 ABY]], multiple ''Tri-Scythes'' participated in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]].<ref name="SWL36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>
